reviews.title: Fairly easy to install hitch. Just remember nothing is exactly Square.
reviews.body: This hitch was fairly easy to install. First what I did was to remove a hold down from the driver's side of the vehicle. Then using one of the bolts from that hold down I was able to clean the threads from the pre-made holes in the bottom of the frame. Next I used a couple of jack stands to hold the hitch in position. The Next Step I did was to attached people into the center hole right behind the back bumper for the center mount. I did not tighten it. Then I was able to install the six bolts that mount the hitch to the side frames. Next before tightening any of the bolts I removed the center mount both and installed a nut for a spacer to take up the space. Then I tightened the three bolts on each side that mounted the hitch to the frame. The final thing was to tighten the two bolts and the center part of the hitch to the frame. See attached pictures. It took me about 45 minutes. It did have good directions except I needed to use an 18 mm socket for the bolts supplied.

reviews.title: Not to good for driving in icy driving **Update**
reviews.body:
Arrived within the time given. Packaging was good. Everything was wrapped and packed well. Directions were a little vague but anybody who’s put together something from IKEA or worked trades should be able to figure it out. Gather the parts, match the pieces up. Loosely assemble pieces. Adjust and tighten nuts and bolts. There are two sets of three brackets. The front ones face foreward, the others face backwards. Took me longer than someone younger and no injuries. Held my 290lb frame without any issues. A little closer to the bottom of the cab than the stock ones I had on my F-250 but it’s not that noticeable to me. Makes it easier to get into my ‘19 Ford F-350 DRW 4x4. I’d order again.
**Update** After using them in the rain and ankle deep mud, there was the same amount of traction as with the stock bars. The only difference is the height of the mounting brackets. A few inches shorter than stock ones. I’ll either have to fabricate longer mounting plates or a second step for under the original tube. Still look good and do the job but maybe on a 2x4 truck. If they could offer a longer option for the mounting brackets that would be nice. My wife is 5’3” and has to really step up to get in. Still good bars, functional, low profile and beats climbing in. Still glad I purchased them.
Update: not to good for snowy weather. The hangers are really short as stated before. Real close to the body/doors and ice builds up when driving and blocks the bottom of the door. We had to push to open the doors. Tried contacting sell to see if there were longer hangers available but I received no reply. Spraying them down with WD-40 helps a little bit. When it gets warm and dry I’ll manufacture some longer brackets.
